messages.text: Hi, I returned the cordless screwdriver. Please send the refund to my new card, the old one was cancelled.

The shop’s records show the cordless screwdriver was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). Refunds can only go to the order’s original payment, not a new card. A cancelled card doesn’t change that; its issuer handles any credit, and the shop can’t promise where or when it will appear (refund-policy/v2/payment).

I haven’t started a refund request. If you want to request the refund to the original payment, let me know.

messages.text: Could you make an exception and send it to my new card ending in 4412 instead?

I can’t make an exception: refunds can’t be sent to another card, and a staff member can’t approve an exception to that rule (refund-policy/v2/payment; refund-policy/v2/exceptions). You can still request the refund to the order’s original payment if you wish.
